extension.description: Keeps the WatchHub add-on and skin up to date automatically.

extension.summary: WatchHub - live sports, free TV and your streaming services in one place
extension.description: Shows what sports are live right now across free services (Pluto TV, Plex, The Roku Channel), your over-the-air PVR channels (e.g. HDHomeRun) and today's TV schedule, and tunes to them with one click by launching the official app or Kodi's PVR.

addon.name: WatchHub

extension.summary: WatchHub - one home screen for live sports, free TV and your streaming services
extension.description: Apple TV / Prime style home screen built around live sports: what is on now, today's games with scores, and your apps - one click to watch. Everything else is Estuary.
